units.unit: Re: we already have an ERP, reply to Lionel
Acknowledges Ironvale already has an ERP

Most customers had an ERP and still chose Tallyhouse
Buyer would be making a mistake not to see demo

reason: Cleaner sentence breaks; same dismissive ERP pitch, so grades stay average.
